pages.title: Galton Board
pages.text: Twelve rows of pegs. Every piece bounces left or right at each, and where it lands sorts it: most near the middle, a few far out in the tails.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Each piece falls through 12 rows of pegs and lands in one of three grades: common (61%), fine (35%) or exceptional (4%) - the binomial distribution, exactly.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 3 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cherenkov Quartz, Copper Ingot, Gold Ingot, Large Deviation Shard, Normal Distribution Crystal, Quartz.
